name: Emberstream
description: One stationary left-facing flame projectile: a rounded hot head, connected scarlet tongues, a subdued purple wake, and three drifting ember accents. The head extinguishes first and the wake last.

textures.prompt: One connected horizontal flame body, rounded head at left and three tapered curling tongues at right. Full texture occupies 75% width and 32% height. Use camera-facing sprite plane with surface flame for animated tail distortion, tint yellow/orange/red; animate opacity, erosion and layered motion.
textures.model: Codex imagegen (model not exposed), reusable library
